Lemma
[$L^1$-norm on a complete noncompact manifold] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0363, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0364, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0365 ↗ lem:chow-iii-dirichlet-heat-kernel-mass-bounds ↗ lem:chow-iii-noncompact-heat-adjoint-symmetry 1. ch26:26.14\group Noncompact Heat Kernels

Suppose $g(\tau )$ is complete and noncompact and \[ \sup |\sec (g(0))|+\sup |\mathcal R_{ij}|+\sup |\nabla _i\mathcal R_{jk}|<\infty . \] If $C_1=\sup |\mathcal R-Q|$, then \[ e^{-C_1(\tau -v)}\le \int _{\mathcal M}H(x,\tau ;y,v) \, d\mu _{g(\tau )}(x)\le e^{C_1(\tau -v)}. \]
Proof

\sketch The upper bound follows by exhausting $\mathcal M$ with Dirichlet kernels. For the lower bound, integrate against distance cutoffs whose Laplacians tend uniformly to zero, then let the cutoff radius tend to infinity.

□
